description: This file contains helper classes and functions for implementing custom TorchScript LSTMs, including various LSTM layer classes, utility functions, and test functions for verifying LSTM implementations.

classes.name: LSTMCell
classes.description: A custom TorchScript implementation of an LSTM cell with forward pass defined.

classes.name: LayerNorm
classes.description: A layer normalization module used within LayerNormLSTMCell.

classes.name: LayerNormLSTMCell
classes.description: An LSTM cell with optional layer normalization applied to gates.

classes.name: LSTMLayer
classes.description: A layer that applies an LSTM cell across a sequence.

classes.name: ReverseLSTMLayer
classes.description: An LSTM layer that processes input in reverse order.

classes.name: BidirLSTMLayer
classes.description: A bidirectional LSTM layer combining forward and backward layers.

classes.name: StackedLSTM
classes.description: A stack of LSTM layers with optional dropout.

classes.name: StackedLSTM2
classes.description: A variant of stacked LSTM that supports multiple directions per layer.

classes.name: StackedLSTMWithDropout
classes.description: A stacked LSTM with dropout applied between layers.

methods.name: script_lstm
methods.description: Creates a scripted LSTM module mimicking PyTorch's native LSTM.

methods.name: script_lnlstm
methods.description: Creates a scripted LayerNorm LSTM module.

methods.name: init_stacked_lstm
methods.description: Initializes a list of stacked LSTM layers.

methods.name: flatten_states
methods.description: Converts a list of LSTM states into a flattened form.

methods.name: double_flatten_states
methods.description: Flattens nested LSTM states for bidirectional or multi-layer configurations.

methods.name: test_script_rnn_layer
methods.description: Test function for a single RNN layer implementation.

methods.name: test_script_stacked_rnn
methods.description: Test function for stacked LSTM layers.

methods.name: test_script_stacked_bidir_rnn
methods.description: Test function for bidirectional stacked LSTM layers.

methods.name: test_script_stacked_lstm_dropout
methods.description: Test function for stacked LSTM with dropout.

methods.name: test_script_stacked_lnlstm
methods.description: Test function for stacked LayerNorm LSTM.
